mail/imap_state#

What SELECT or EXAMINE reports about a mailbox, kept up to date by later responses.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let inbox = await session.mailbox(ImapMailboxName("INBOX"));
let state = await inbox.state();
state.messages();                       // EXISTS
state.uid_validity();
if state.has_first_unseen() { state.first_unseen(); }

Description#

What SELECT or EXAMINE reports about a mailbox, kept up to date by later responses.

UNSEEN in SELECT is the number of the first unseen message, not a count. RECENT and UIDNEXT are optional. An EXPUNGE adjusts the counts.
